name: Why hire a general remodeling contractor for cabin upgrades instead of a stain-only crew?

mainEntity.name: Why hire a general remodeling contractor for cabin upgrades instead of a stain-only crew?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a full-scope remodeling contractor allows you to address the entire living space in a single, coordinated project. Cabins often need more than exterior wood care; interior spaces frequently require drywall repairs where logs meet framed walls, updated bathroom tile, finish carpentry, new moldings, or interior painting. A general contractor coordinates these diverse trades alongside log restoration, serving as your single point of contact. This integrated approach ensures structural timber interfaces, interior finishes, and moisture barriers align seamlessly without managing multiple independent crews.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general remodeling contractor handles log sealing alongside interior carpentry, drywall, tile, and painting, providing a single point of contact for the whole cabin.
